properties.category: Video - Always Point of View in description - In the colour of who is doing the attack or is responsable for the incident in the video.
properties.description: Rough point of view looking in a west direction - a huge plume of smoke is visible in Donetsk following a reported Ukrainian strike. The smoke appears to be coming from the direction of the Research Institute of Integrated Automation (NIIKA), which was designated on 08 September 2025 as a claimed position of the Command post of the 41st Combined Arms Army
